title: Praying at the Airport
paragraphs: Danial has a long layover between two flights, and Asr prayer time arrives while he is still waiting at the gate. He looks around the terminal and finds a quiet prayer room near the food court.

Inside, he meets two other travelers he has never seen before, also stopping to pray during their journey. They exchange a quick, friendly greeting before starting their prayer together in the small, calm room.

The three of them speak briefly afterward, discovering they are on completely different flights heading to different countries, yet united for a few minutes by the same simple routine in an unfamiliar building.
After praying, Danial feels more settled for the rest of his long trip. He realizes that even in the busiest, most unfamiliar places, a short prayer can create a small sense of home.
